title: Government Approves ₹28 Billion Program for Lithium and Nickel Processing
summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a ₹28.14 billion (~$297.06 million) capital expenditure (CAPEX) support program to promote domestic processing of lithium, nickel and other critical minerals.These minerals find use in sectors such as electric mobility, battery energy storage, electronics, defense, and specialty steel.

direction_reasons: CAPEX cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
watch_next: confirmation from an official or company source
WAAREEENER.why_it_matters: This is industry-level news rather than company news via its product exposure to battery energy storage. The parts of the business most likely touched are cash flow, balance sheet. Classified as capex.
